Name: DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[b][color=#8e7cc3][size=3]★[/size][/color][size=2] A new interface mod for you! I designed this to match [b]Earthy Recolour[/b], but it also looks great on its own or with other recolour mods [/size][color=#8e7cc3][size=3]★[/size][/color][/b]

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][b].°˖✧ earthy collection: [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255][b]exterior recolour[/b][/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790][b]interior recolour[/b][/url] [/b]✧˖°.[/b][/size][/font]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/FlWVxfK.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Changes the game's UI (menus, buttons, dialogue boxes) to a darker, more neutral colour palette [/b][/*]
[*][b]12 different accent colours to choose from — or randomise daily or change with the seasons[/b][/*]
[*][b]All game languages supported[/b][/*]
[/list][b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QsemUE7.png[/img]﻿
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]AccentColour[color=#999999] | [/color][color=#76a5af]Slate[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#e06666]Maroon[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#a64d79]Plum[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#b45f06]Sienna[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#bf9000]Olive[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#6aa84f]Forest[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#45818e]Emerald[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#3d85c6]Navy[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#6d9eeb]Cornflower[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#674ea7]Eggplant[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#cc4125]Scarlet[/color][color=#999999], [/color][color=#666666]Coal[/color][color=#999999], Seasonal, Random[/color][/b][/*]
[*][b]SpringDefault[color=#999999] | for Seasonal option[/color][/b][/*]
[*][b]SummerDefault[b] [color=#999999]| for Seasonal option[/color][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b]FallDefault[b][color=#666666] [/color][color=#999999]| for Seasonal option[/color][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b]WinterDefault[b] [color=#999999]| for Seasonal option[/color][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b]RecolourCursors [/b][b][color=#999999]| true or false | set to false if you want to use a different mod for cursors[/color][/b][/*]
[/list][color=#999999][b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1EhY4eo.png[/img]﻿
[/b][/color]
[b]﻿1. Install [/b][url=http://smapi.io][b]SMAPI[/b][/url][b] and [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url]
[b]  ﻿2. Download this mod and extract the "[CP] DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface" folder to [/b][i][b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/i]
[b]﻿3. (optional but highly recommended) Install [/b][url=https://blog.naver.com/khs3400/222049471897]FixFontOption[/url] [b]-- scroll to the bottom of the page and download version 1.1.9)[/b]
﻿[b]4. Run the game via the StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b]
